high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "sofia_isella," who posted it 12 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post is a blue-themed graphic with white text that repeatedly states "NO KINGS IN AMERICA" in large, bold letters. This text is layered over a smaller section that contains a tweet from another user named "danieldantastic," which was posted 17 hours prior. The tweet from "danieldantastic" includes a caption that reads: "700 marines are being deployed to keep you from thinking about this." Below
